name: lengthlab-recovery
description: Censoring-aware length estimator: minimize recovery error of median/q90/P(length>=c) vs generator truth on visible regimes.
rules: No network. No provider calls. Never import effort_atlas.client.
One hypothesis per iteration, written to the run log before scoring.
AGENTS.md safeguards 1, 2, 5 apply verbatim; a protected path is read-only.
Final numbers come from final_eval.py (human-run, holdout seed), never from this metric.
